summary: Safe Bulkers, Inc. filed a Form 6-K to disclose major shareholdings under Greek Law 3556/2007 following the parallel listing of its common stock on Euronext Athens. The filing reports that entities controlled by Mr. Polys Hajioannou collectively hold 48,381,427 shares, or 47.51% of total voting rights, with Vorini Holdings Inc., Akamas Maritime Inc., and Chalkoessa Maritime Inc. holding 19.08%, 8.40%, and 5.30% respectively. This is a routine regulatory notification of existing ownership, not a special situation transaction. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics to analyze. No risk-arb angle applies as no transaction is proposed.
